cim: Montefiore Nyack Hospital Becomes First Community Hospital in Nation to Earn National AI Recognition
cim_eredeti: Montefiore Nyack Hospital Becomes First Community Hospital in Nation to Earn National AI Recognition
szoveg_eredeti:
Montefiore Nyack Hospital has become the first community hospital in the United States to receive a prestigious national recognition from the American College of Radiology (ACR) for its responsible use of artificial intelligence in medical imaging.

The hospital announced that it has earned recognition through the ACR’s Recognized Center for Healthcare-AI (ARCH-AI) program, the nation’s first artificial intelligence quality assurance initiative specifically designed for radiology facilities.

Montefiore Nyack Hospital began incorporating artificial intelligence into its radiology operations in 2018 and now utilizes a variety of FDA-approved AI technologies to improve patient care.

These advanced tools assist radiologists in identifying urgent medical findings, accelerating communication among stroke treatment teams, analyzing brain structures through MRI scans, and supporting breast cancer screening.

Hospital President and CEO Dr. Mark E. Geller emphasized that the national recognition reflects the hospital’s commitment to providing patients with reliable, high-quality medical imaging services.

The ARCH-AI recognition requires participating facilities to meet rigorous standards for patient safety, technology oversight, staff training, cybersecurity, and continuous monitoring of AI performance.

According to hospital officials, every artificial intelligence tool undergoes extensive testing using the hospital’s own data before being introduced into patient care and remains under ongoing supervision to ensure its safety and effectiveness.

The milestone highlights Montefiore Nyack Hospital’s continued investment in advanced medical technology and its commitment to improving healthcare services for Rockland County residents.
